items.headline: Louisiana and Troy meet in Sun Belt play
items.description: Troy (3-2) at Louisiana (4-2), Oct. 17 at 5 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Southern Miss Golden Eagles vs. Troy Trojans: Full Highlights
items.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles vs. Troy Trojans: Full Highlights

items.headline: Goose Crowder throws for 2 TDs, runs for 2 more as Troy beats Southern Miss 55-34 to open Sun Belt
items.description: — Goose Crowder threw for two touchdowns, and he added two scores on the ground to help Troy beat Southern Miss 55-34 on Tuesday night in a Sun Belt Conference opener for both teams.

items.headline: Southern Miss visits Troy in Sun Belt matchup
items.description: Southern Miss (1-3) at Troy (2-2), Oct. 6 at 8 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Grady Brosterhous throws for 242 yards and 2 TDs to help Utah State beat Troy 21-10
items.description: — Grady Brosterhous threw for 242 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 89 yards as Utah State scored 14 unanswered points in the second half to beat Troy 21-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Roberts runs for 122 yards and a TD, No. 20 Missouri hangs on after a slow start to beat Troy 27-17
items.description: — Jamal Roberts ran for 128 yards and a touchdown, DaMarion Folkes returned a punt 68 yards for another score, and No. 20 Missouri shook off a slow start before holding on to beat Troy 27-17 on Saturday night.
